This role supports compliance functions of the Principal Securities and Principal Funds Distributor broker dealers by independently conducting regulatory research, interpreting developments, and identifying risk exposures related to broker dealer obligations in the domestic Principal product and services and their distribution. The role is part of a compliance practice group broadly supporting broker-dealer compliance for the retirement, insurance and asset management offerings of Principal. Responsibilities include assisting in the design and drafting of policies and procedures, participating in testing and examinations, preparing reports and filings, recommending corrective actions, mentoring colleagues, and contributing to process enhancements. The role engages broadly across internal teams, supports implementation of compliance initiatives, and begins to operate with increased independence.

Data Analysis – Gather and organize information from multiple sources (e.g., compliance reports, audit results, incident logs, regulatory documents). Compile, aggregate, and analyze data using basic statistics; identify patterns, trends, or anomalies to support compliance decisions. Use tools like Excel (formulas, charts), introductory SQL, and visualization platforms (e.g., Tableau, Power BI) to structure and present data. Ensure accuracy and completeness of data; correct errors, double-check entries, and summarize findings for reporting and decision-making.
Regulatory Research – Conduct research on laws, regulations, and industry standards (e.g., AML, KYC, GDPR, HIPAA, market conduct) to support compliance initiatives. Stay informed on regulatory developments by using legal databases, publications, and other reliable sources. Interpret legal language and compile findings into clear, actionable reports that highlight potential business impacts. Support regulatory examinations and documentation by reviewing sources and maintaining thorough records. Assist with tracking and reporting on regulatory changes that may affect business operations.
Risk Management – Monitor business activities and review materials (e.g., training, policies) to identify compliance risks and exposures. Assist with compliance testing, compliance monitoring and examinations; facilitate documentation requests and analyze findings. Support identification of corrective actions based on internal policies and external regulations. Apply risk management principles under supervision; escalate issues and begin assessing regulatory impacts on risk profiles. Review and approve deliverables using a risk-based approach to decision-making to support business goals while ensuring compliance with regulatory requirements and company policies.
Communications & Reporting – Write clear, concise compliance reports, filings, policies, training materials and procedures. Present findings and recommendations to various audiences; participate in meetings and training sessions. Maintain accurate records of compliance activities; update documentation and escalate issues when needed. Handle correspondence with auditors and regulators; explain requirements and findings in accessible language.
Process Improvement – Assist in drafting and implementing compliance policies, procedures, and controls. Document current workflows; identify inefficiencies, bottlenecks, or error points.Propose and communicate practical improvements; gather metrics and feedback to support changes.Participate in improvement initiatives by collaborating with team members and applying structured problem-solving and process enhancement methodologies.

This is a senior tax compliance role responsible for complex federal, state, local, and international tax reporting and regulatory requirements.

You will manage high-impact tax activities across a complex healthcare and academic environment, including unrelated business income, indirect taxes, international taxation, and regulatory reporting.

The role combines detailed tax research and analysis with compliance monitoring, risk assessment, audit readiness, and policy development.

You will work across departments to identify tax implications, resolve compliance issues, and provide clear guidance on complex transactions and organizational initiatives.

The position also plays an important role in maintaining accurate records, strengthening internal controls, and ensuring timely filings and payments.

You will collaborate with internal stakeholders, external tax consultants, and regulatory authorities while staying current with evolving federal and state requirements.

This fully remote opportunity is well suited to an analytical, detail-oriented tax professional who enjoys complex problem-solving and operating in a highly regulated environment.

Prepare, reconcile, file, and administer federal, state, and local tax obligations, ensuring accurate and timely compliance with applicable laws and regulations.

jobs.description:
Description

This role is for a Customer Success Manager (CSM) on the Zappos FBA Preferred Partnerships team. The position is a new headcount designed to serve as a dedicated strategic growth partner for assigned footwear brands within our Preferred Partnership Program (PPP).

The CSM will operate as the primary relationship owner and trusted advisor for their brand portfolio, personally engaging with vendor stakeholders to develop trust, influence strategic decisions, and align brand goals with Amazon growth opportunities. This role requires navigating complex multi-stakeholder environments, influencing without authority across internal teams (Buying & Planning, Supply Chain, Advertising), and building durable partnerships through consistent personal engagement, transparent communication, and accountable follow-through.

This role is highly visible and requires a balance of tactical execution and strategic relationship management. Success in this role means earning the trust of brand partners through reliable personal engagement, driving selection growth through coordinated investment, and strengthening the scalability of the PPP through accountable partnership ownership.

Key job responsibilities

Partnership Ownership & Relationship Management: Serve as the dedicated point of contact for assigned footwear brands, building trusted advisory relationships through regular touchpoints, proactive communication, and responsive issue resolution. Engage with brand stakeholders to understand their business objectives and translate them into actionable growth strategies. Maintain defined response SLAs and conduct quarterly Partnership Health Reviews.

Strategic Growth & Business Planning: Develop Joint Business Plans with buyers and vendors to align growth priorities and partnership commitments. Create one-page Brand Growth Briefs covering demand signals, whitespace opportunities, and exclusivity strategies. Attend market appointments to influence buy depth and surface growth opportunities with brand decision-makers.

Demand Acceleration & Investment Coordination: Coordinate Sponsored Ads, merchandising, promotions, and catalog optimization to drive traffic, conversion, and organic rank growth. Manage deal mechanics and identify cost-engineered opportunities for event eligibility.

Controlled Distribution & Customer Experience: Monitor seller fragmentation, Featured Offer ownership, and pricing consistency. Coordinate Brand Store, A+ Content, and catalog updates to improve listing quality and customer trust.

Reporting & Operational Excellence: Deliver monthly Brand Exposure Reports and weekly business recaps. Build scalable reporting and process improvements to support program growth.

A day in the life

Your day might start reviewing Featured Offer trends and seller fragmentation for a Priority Partner, then shift to coordinating a Sponsored Ads campaign launch with the media team. Mid-morning, you're on a call with a brand stakeholder discussing their quarterly growth plan. After lunch, you're preparing a one-page exclusivity brief for an upcoming market appointment, then submitting deal mechanics for a high-velocity event. You close the day delivering a vendor digest and flagging pricing risks to the buying team. No two days look the same, but every day connects brand strategy to measurable Amazon outcomes.

About The Team

The Preferred Partnerships Program (PPP) is a growth and distribution management team within Zappos FBA team. We serve as strategic partners to premium footwear brands, helping them grow on Amazon through controlled distribution, coordinated advertising investment, and accountable ownership. Our Customer Success Managers work alongside Buying & Planning to accelerate demand, expand exclusivity, optimize Featured Offer performance, and improve the customer experience. We manage a tiered portfolio of Priority, Growth, and Emerging partners, scaling investment and support based on each brand's strategic value and commitment level.

Basic Qualifications

Bachelor's degree or equivalent
2+ years in a client-facing role within Customer Success, Account Management, Buying, Merchandising, or Strategic Partnerships owning external client/vendor relationships
Proven ability to build trusted advisory relationships with external stakeholders
Track record driving measurable partner outcomes (revenue growth, operational improvements, or adoption)
Experience collaborating with cross-functional teams to drive partner or business outcomes
Experience presenting data-backed business reviews to stakeholders
